videos.script: Lesson eleven ended with a plan. This lesson tests it, the only way that tests anything: by sending the load. {{plan}} Our load generator so far was closed: it waits for each answer before asking again. Real buyers arrive at a rate, and do not wait for each other. {{models}} Freeze the box office for two seconds. The closed test barely notices. The open one says one sale in twenty took two seconds. {{omission}} Then a stress test, up to four hundred sales a second. The first thing to break is not the box office, but a default in nginx. {{stress}} Fixed, the failures become answers, and the real capacity shows: about a hundred and eighty a second for one copy. {{fixed}} And the plan itself, with thresholds. One copy fails it by seconds. Three copies pass. {{verdict}}
